summary: Ran 21-test pytest suite for DaySync auth + multi-tenant isolation + visibility + logo (20/21 passed). Exercised full Expo web flow: welcome → admin register → profile → admin route → sign out → join screen → login. Two blocking bugs found: (1) Invite code screen never shows after admin registration (RouteGuard preempts setStep); (2) POST /api/company/logo returns a logo_url built from FastAPI request.base_url which resolves to the internal cluster URL (http://gpt-cross-platform.cluster-9.preview.emergentcf.cloud) instead of the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, so uploaded logos are 403 Forbidden when the client tries to display them.

critical.issue: Returned logo_url uses request.base_url which resolves to internal cluster host (http://...cluster-9.preview.emergentcf.cloud) and is not reachable from the public domain (returns 403 via CF). Frontend cannot render the logo. Fix: build the URL from an env var (e.g. EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL or a new PUBLIC_BASE_URL) instead of request.base_url in server.py upload_logo (line ~425).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful admin registration, setStep('invite') never renders. RouteGuard's useEffect sees user is authenticated + segments[0]=='(auth)' and calls router.replace('/(tabs)') immediately, unmounting the invite screen before it can display. Users never see their invite code. Fix options: (a) in RouteGuard, allow (auth) group to remain if a query/param like ?post=1 is set; (b) show the invite code as a modal from the (tabs) group after signup; or (c) defer setUser in AuthContext until the invite screen 'Continue' is tapped for signUpAdmin (persist token + set a local 'pendingUser' state, then commit on Continue).

Sign out button (testID logout-btn) can be obscured by the bottom tab bar on shorter viewports — requires manual scroll to hit reliably. contentContainerStyle paddingBottom is 140 but the admin tile + team list can still push logout beyond visible area. Consider increasing paddingBottom or adding scrollIntoView / sticky footer.

integration_issues.issue: End-to-end broken — admin cannot copy/share invite code from the post-signup screen because it never mounts. They must navigate to Profile → Admin settings to find the invite code, which is not the intended UX.
Upload succeeds but the returned URL is unreachable from the app (403). Displayed logo will always be broken until backend URL bug is fixed.

issues: Console deprecation warnings persist: 'shadow*' style props (use boxShadow), 'props.pointerEvents' (use style.pointerEvents). Non-blocking.

action_items: Fix invite-code screen: prevent RouteGuard from redirecting admins away from /(auth)/register-admin before they tap Continue. Simplest fix: keep the invite screen alive by holding off on setUser in AuthContext for signUpAdmin (return token+user+invite to caller, persist token, but only setUser after Continue is pressed).
Fix POST /api/company/logo to construct logo_url from a public base URL env var (e.g. os.environ['PUBLIC_BASE_URL'] or the EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL) instead of request.base_url.
Ensure Sign out button on Profile is always reachable without manual scroll (increase bottom padding or move to a sticky footer).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py upload_logo builds public URL from request.base_url — unreliable behind reverse proxies. Use env-configured base URL.

AuthContext.signUpAdmin persists user immediately, causing the (auth)-side invite screen to be preempted by RouteGuard. Decouple token persistence from user-state activation for the admin signup case.
server.py uses @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — deprecated in newer FastAPI; migrate to lifespan handler.
server.py: All list/get endpoints correctly project out _id and password_hash. Good.
server.py: Multi-tenant isolation is enforced by filtering on company_id in every event/task query — verified good.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed companies+users each run; nothing persisted for reuse.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend auth+isolation+visibility all pass. Two critical bugs to retest after fix: (1) after admin signup, the invite code screen must render before hitting (tabs); look for testID 'admin-continue' and 'invite-code' text after clicking admin-submit. (2) after POST /api/company/logo, GET the returned logo_url and assert 200 image/* (currently returns 403 because URL uses internal cluster host). Join screen testIDs: join-code, join-name, join-email, join-password, join-submit. Profile-tab admin-nav testID is 'open-admin' (not 'profile-admin-link'). Header profile shortcut uses testID 'header-profile-btn' and routes to /settings.
rca_of_issue: Invite-screen bug: signUpAdmin() calls persist(token, user) which sets user in AuthProvider. RouteGuard's useEffect on [user, segments] then fires and calls router.replace('/(tabs)') because segments[0]==='(auth)' and user is truthy. This unmounts register-admin.tsx before its setStep('invite') state can render. Reproduction: clear localStorage → /welcome → Create a company → fill form → Submit → observe URL becomes '/' (Today) with no invite screen and no 'admin-continue' testID. Fix: in signUpAdmin, do NOT set user until Continue is tapped; only persist the token and return {invite_code, tempUser}. Logo bug RCA: FastAPI's request.base_url reflects the direct upstream host (cluster-9 domain, HTTP), not the public Cloudflare-fronted domain. Fix by building URL from an env var. Both are simple, high-impact fixes.
